pem_variants.description: PEM sources accepted by NewManagerWithSources (JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM / JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM). Private: PKCS#1 then PKCS#8 (RSA only). Public: PKIX then X.509 certificate. Text before the first PEM block is ignored by pem.Decode. Go never checks that the private and public keys match. *_source names a file under testdata/golden or "inline" (then *_pem holds the value). private_transform: prepend_text_line = "comment line before the block\n" + file; escape_newlines = TrimSpace(file) with every newline replaced by the two characters backslash-n (a common env-var mistake; Go rejects it).
